comment: Differences of tests/abi/data_transfer.py from the Chromium oracle tests/fixtures/data-transfer-oracle.json: each path (case.key[.index]) with both recorded values and its reason. An entry with "platforms" applies only on those platforms.

differences.reason: WebKit with custom pasteboard data off (DeprecatedGlobalSettings, every port's default) lists a DataTransfer's types from its pasteboard alone: a File added to the item list adds no "Files" type, and the item list exposes only the text/plain, text/html and text/uri-list strings.

In the protected mode of dragenter, dragover and dragleave WebKit's item list lists the strings, and of the files only promised image and media types (DataTransferItemList::ensureItems); Chromium lists every file item.
WebKit leaves dropEffect uninitialized, read as "none", during the drag events until a listener sets it (EventHandler::dispatchDragEnterOrDragOverEvent); Chromium initializes it from effectAllowed.
